gate: Current recommendation is hold. Execute nothing unless root reopens an exact independent-reviewed source proposal after the active performance comparison.
performance: Root owns any later bounded comparison. A same-set-bind frequency alone is not a saved-time claim. Retain M3 as a first-class beneficiary; do not trade its performance away for relative M4 gains.
requiredCPUCases: First bind, repeated equal data, equal pointer with changed metadata, changed pointer, zero/nonzero offsets, multiple sets and per-stage consumption.

Zero-growth counterexample: P1 set0 A has one dynamic descriptor and set1 S has one, offsets [0,0]; P2 changes set0 to B with two, retaining a compatible S definition, offsets [0,0,0]. The implicit payload must rebind with three words even if every value is zero.
Prefix-layout/packing change, equal counts with different associations, shrink/grow/partial rebind, no-dynamic argument-buffer fast path, and conservative Off-mode handling.
Resource-use affected clearing remains exact, including a state-level X-to-Y update at the same address; distinguish this modeled contract from a legal Vulkan runtime reproduction.
Fresh encoder, graphics/compute stage switch, helper overwritten root bindings, native table slot revisions and copied/restored state must retain original first-use behavior.

Use selected cases from tools/tests/metal4-vulkan-integration.mm and tools/tests/metal4-prepared-recording-vulkan.mm for native descriptor/layout/helper behavior; no unrelated full suite.
